pages.title: Smokeless Dash
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Elytra$(br2)§lEffect: §r While gliding, grants continuous forward thrust without using firework rockets; sprinting while gliding provides stronger thrust. Speed is capped at about 1.6 blocks/tick to prevent loss of control.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
